input.title: Economic crimes in the capital markets
input.abstract: The purpose of this paper is to present an alternate view regarding enforcement of currency control laws to the real estate market. Historical research and comparison of similar although not parallel systems. Based on historical data, present approaches are not working. Suggests new approach by incentivizing those to the potential crime. The paper will be of value to law-enforcement policy makers. © 2008, Emerald Group Publishing Limited

output.reasoning: O artigo não atende aos critérios básicos de busca por palavras-chave do protocolo (métodos computacionais, lavagem de dinheiro ou crime organizado) nos campos de título, resumo ou palavras-chave dos autores.
